WITH matched_fees AS (
  SELECT u.acctscope, o.recordvault, f.feerate, f.rebrate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink
  JOIN users AS u ON u.userstamp = o.userlink
), per_order AS (
  SELECT acctscope, recordvault,
         AVG(feerate) - AVG(rebrate) AS net_rate
  FROM matched_fees
  GROUP BY acctscope, recordvault
  HAVING AVG(feerate) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(rebrate) IS NOT NULL
), per_scope AS (
  SELECT acctscope, AVG(net_rate) AS avg_net_rate, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM per_order
  GROUP BY acctscope
)
SELECT acctscope, avg_net_rate, order_count,
       avg_net_rate - AVG(avg_net_rate) OVER () AS difference_from_plain_scope_average
FROM per_scope;

assumptions.assumption: An order is identified by orders.recordvault, and its net rate is included only when both its average feerate and average rebrate are present; NULL rate values are ignored by AVG.
